channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: ASPI's Cutler on Trump-Xi Summit, Trade Relations
item.description: Wendy Cutler, Senior Vice President at the Asia Society Policy Institute and former Acting Deputy US Trade Representative, discusses the outlook for US-China trade relations after US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the two countries had agreed to a two-month extension of their trade truce. She speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: PGIM's Singh on Global Economy, China-US relations
item.description: Daleep Singh, Vice Chair and Chief Global Economist at PGIM, discusses his outlook for the global economy, inflation and rates, as leaders of the world's two most powerful economies meet in Washington for a high level summit on trade and AI. He speaks with Haidi Stroud Watts on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AmCham Shanghai President on Trump-Xi summit
item.description: Eric Zheng, President of AmCham Shanghai, discusses his expectations for Chinese President Xi and US President Trump's high level summit in Washington, and its potential implications for US businesses working operating in China. He speaks with Stephen Engle in Washington on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Hong Kong Seeks Up to $2.6 Billion in Record Digital Bond Sale
item.description: Hong Kong is seeking to raise HK$15 billion to HK$20 billion ($1.9 billion to $2.6 billion) through a multi-currency digital green bond offering that would be the world’s largest of its kind, according to people familiar with the matter, as the city pushes to become a fixed-income hub.
item.dc:creator: Aileen Chuang and Janice Huang

item.title: Meta Debuts Lightweight $1,299 VR Glasses
item.description: Meta is expanding its smart-glasses lineup with its first camera-free models, support for the new Muse assistant and a new hearing-aid mode. And the new lightweight VR headset promises to reset the category, explains Mark Gurman. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Meta Debuts Dedicated Muse Charm Gadget for AI Assistant Users
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. unveiled a palm-sized, dedicated gadget for using Muse, the company’s popular new artificial intelligence assistant, pushing deeper into the AI devices market with a surprise announcement.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Meta Launches $1,299 VR Headset That Look Like Glasses to Rival Apple Vision Pro
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. on Wednesday launched $1,299 virtual-reality glasses that undercut Apple Inc. in price and size while putting its headset line on track for profitability.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Meta Debuts $349 Camera-Free Ray-Bans and Brings Muse to Glasses
item.description: Meta Platforms Inc. is expanding its smart-glasses lineup with camera-free models, support for the popular new Muse assistant and a hearing-aid mode.
item.dc:creator: Mark Gurman

item.title: Revolut Is Bringing Facial-Recognition Checkout to UK Businesses
item.description: Revolut Ltd. is piloting a new point-of-sale system in the UK that will let customers make in-store payments using their faces, as it pushes to bank more businesses.
item.dc:creator: Charlie Wells

item.title: DTCC CEO on Market Structure, 24/7 Trading
item.description: President, CEO and Director of DTCC Frank La Salla sat down Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick from the Financial Markets Quality Conference at Georgetown University to break down the hidden side of how the markets operate, and where the industry is headed from here. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Reena Aggarwal: Expect Merging of Private & Public
item.description: Reena Aggarwal, Robert E. McDonough Professor of Finance and Director of the Psaros Center for Financial Markets & Policy at Georgetown University’s McDonough School of Business, sat down Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick from the Financial Markets Quality Conference at Georgetown University to discuss the relationship between public and private markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Startups Modal, Baseten in Funding Talks to Help Businesses Run AI
item.description: Two startups that provide platforms to help businesses run artificial intelligence models are in talks to raise capital that could at least double their valuations, a sign of surging investor demand for infrastructure services.Modal Labs is in talks to raise new financing at a roughly $15 billion valuation, according to two people familiar with the matter, roughly triple what it was worth in a round four months ago. item.dc:creator: Natasha Mascarenhas and Dina Bass

item.title: Toner: There’s a Lot of Upside To AI if We Do It Right
item.description: Helen Toner, Executive Director at Georgetown's Center for Security and Emerging Technology and Former OpenAI Board Member sat down Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick from the Financial Markets Quality Conference at Georgetown University to break down the status of AI regulation in the US, the AI race with China, and where she thinks AI pacing should go from here. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Former CFTC Commissioner on Prediction Market Regulation
item.description: Former CFTC Commissioner and Kalshi Exchange Board Member Brian Quintenz speaks about the firm's margin trading request to the CFTC with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick from the Financial Markets Quality Conference at Georgetown University. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: YouTube Says New AI Tools Will Help Creators, not Replace Them
item.description: YouTube announced a flurry of product updates Wednesday aimed at showcasing its latest AI capabilities while also easing concerns that the technology will make creators obsolete.
item.dc:creator: Alexandra S. Levine

item.title: SEC Commissioner: We’ll Ensure Guardrails for Tokenization
item.description: SEC Commissioner Mark Uyeda discusses the SEC’s push to rethink core parts of market structure, including where stocks trade, how prices are discovered, company reporting frequency, shareholder voting, and whether private assets belong in retirement accounts. Uyeda said the current approach emphasizes pilot projects and guardrails, arguing the agency wants to gather observations and data before proposing new rules. He speaks with Romaine Bostick live from the Psaros Center at Georgetown University on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: CoreWeave-Tied Data Center Raises $1.1 Billion in Junk Bonds
item.description: A data center developer sponsored by affiliates of Blue Owl Capital Inc. raised $1.1 billion through a junk-bond offering to finance a CoreWeave Inc.-tied project after offering juicy yields to lure investors.
item.dc:creator: Gowri Gurumurthy

item.title: OpenAI Agent Hacked Australian Government Website, Albanese Says
item.description: An OpenAI model hacked an Australian government website earlier this year, marking one of the first known cyberattacks by AI on a government database.
item.dc:creator: Ainsley Thomson and James Mayger

item.title: Xi and Trump Seek Safe AI Without Slowing Race for Supremacy
item.description: Xi Jinping and Donald Trump will sit down this week to hash out a plethora of thorny issues from trade to Taiwan. One thing both sides agree on: neither can afford to tap the brakes on AI.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: SoftBank Pays Record Yields to Become Goliath of Junk Bonds
item.description: Billionaire Masayoshi Son’s SoftBank Group Corp. pushed through one of the largest junk-bond offerings on record, dangling yields above anything it’s paid before in an effort to fund its massive AI ambitions.
item.dc:creator: Takahiko Hyuga, Janice Huang, Gowri Gurumurthy and Ronan Martin
